parts.title: Major Themes Across John 1-3
items: A Gospel that opens before Genesis rather than at a genealogy
One word chosen because it lands in the Greek room and the Hebrew room at once
Light that darkness could neither put out nor understand
A Word who pitched His tent in the middle of the camp
Chesed and emet - the words spoken over Moses - walking around in a body
The law handed down, and grace and truth arriving in person
A witness who refused three titles and claimed only to be a sound
A Lamb announced without saying which lamb, because it may be all of them
Come and see, offered twice, and no argument made anywhere in the chapter
Found and brought - the only evangelism method in John 1
A man with no deceit, greeted by the name of a man who had nothing else
Jacob's ladder with a Person where the ladder used to be
A mother's last recorded words: whatever He says to you, do it
Six stone jars, one short of seven, filled to the brim
Water for washing turned into wine for a wedding, and the jars never broken
Servants who knew because they had obeyed, and a steward who did not
A bridegroom congratulated for something he did not do
Signs rather than mighty works - power that points past itself
A whip used on the animals, and words used on the sellers of the poor man's dove
My Father's house, said first and claimed as a son
Destroy this temple, given as an imperative rather than a proposal
Belief that He would not entrust Himself to
A ruler who came at night and buried Him in daylight
One word meaning both again and from above, and a conversation running on it
A teacher of Israel told he had missed his own Scriptures
Wind known by what it moves and not by where it began
A cure shaped like the thing that was killing them
Lifted up, meaning a cross and a throne in the same breath
So loved, meaning in this way, and pointing back at a pole in the wilderness
A judgment that is a preference rather than a sentence
A friend of the bridegroom whose success is his own redundancy
A great man's last recorded sentence, and it is about getting smaller

parts.title: Major Themes Across John 4-6
items: The Word made flesh, tired enough to sit down on the edge of a well
A road through Samaria that He needed to take, and a woman He went to find
Three walls crossed with one request for a drink
Living water mistaken for plumbing, and offered anyway
A past named without shame and without being skipped
Worship that is no longer a question of which mountain
A Father who goes looking for worshippers
I am He, said first to a Samaritan woman at noon
A water jar left behind by someone who found a well
A whole town brought by the person who had been avoiding it
Food the disciples did not know about: doing the will of the one who sent Him
Fields already white, and Samaritans coming down the road
The Savior of the world, named first by outsiders
A father who believed a sentence before he saw anything
A word that healed from twenty miles away at the very hour it was spoken
Thirty-eight years by a pool, the length of a wilderness generation
Do you want to be made well, answered with a reason instead of a yes
Grace that went first and asked questions later
Accusers who walked past a miracle to get to a mat
A Father who never stops working, and a Son who does what He does
Equality with God, understood perfectly by those who rejected it
Life and judgment, the two works only God does, claimed by the Son
All who are in the tombs hearing His voice
Four witnesses called, because the Torah requires more than one
Searching the Scriptures and missing the Person they are about
Moses, called as the final witness against those who claimed him
A boy's barley lunch in the hands of the one who made the grain
Fragments gathered so that nothing is lost, as He loses none of His
A crown refused because it was offered by full stomachs
The one who treads on the waves of the sea, saying I AM in the dark
Bread wanted, sign missed, and the Giver overlooked
Not Moses but My Father, not gave but gives, not something but someone
A hard saying made harder rather than softer
The life in the blood, offered for the life of the world
Will you also go away, and nowhere else to go

parts.title: Major Themes Across John 7-9
items: Brothers at the same table who did not believe, and one of them who later did
A time that is never ready for Him and always ready for those it costs nothing
Whispers in the city and no one willing to speak openly
Understanding that follows obedience rather than preceding it
Accused of breaking the Sabbath by men plotting murder
Circumcision on the eighth day, and a whole man made well
Judging by appearance instead of with righteous judgment
A shout on the last day of the water feast
Rivers of living water flowing from the one standing in the temple
Officers sent to arrest Him who were arrested by what they heard
Nicodemus speaking up in daylight, and paying for it
Experts so angry they forgot Jonah came from Galilee
A woman used as bait, and a man who was never brought
The finger that wrote the tablets, writing in the dust
Stones dropped one by one, beginning with the oldest
Neither do I condemn you, and go and sin no more, kept together
The light of the world, spoken beside the great lamps of the feast
I am, in Isaiah's words, and dying in sin for refusing it
Truth that makes free, offered to people who insisted they were never slaves
A son who stays in the house, and a slave who does not
Descent from Abraham without likeness to him
No one in a hostile crowd able to name a single sin
Abraham rejoicing to see a day he could only see from far off
Before Abraham came to be, I AM
Stones lifted by men who understood the claim perfectly
A man noticed before he asked for anything
Suffering that is not a sentence
Eyes made from dust a second time by the hands that made them the first
A walk to a pool called Sent, blind, on nothing but a word
Neighbors who could not accept a changed life
One thing I know: I was blind and now I see
A beggar who already counted himself a disciple
Thrown out by men and found by Him
From a man called Jesus to Lord, I believe, and worship
The only blindness that cannot be healed is the kind that says it sees

parts.title: Major Themes Across John 10-12
items: False shepherds who threw a healed sheep over the wall
A shepherd who calls his own by name and goes before them
The door, lying across the gap so nothing passes but over Him
Life overflowing, not life barely kept
Yahweh Himself the shepherd, and David's son set over the flock, both at once
A hired hand who runs, and an owner who lays down his life
Other sheep, one flock, one shepherd
A life no one took, laid down and taken up on His own authority
One hand holding the sheep, called His and the Father's
I and the Father are one, the Shema spoken from within
The one set apart and sent, at the feast of setting apart
Everything John said about Him proved true
A message that named the need and trusted the love
Love and delay joined by the word therefore
Thomas the doubter as the man who said let us die with Him
Martha's correct theology meeting the resurrection in person
Truth for Martha and tears for Mary, after the same sentence
Anger at death and tears at a tomb He was about to empty
Faith on the road faltering at the stone
A dead man called by name, and grave clothes loosed by others
The miracle that sealed His death
A prophecy spoken unknowingly by the high priest who wanted Him dead
Scattered children gathered into one
A pound of nard and a house filled with its fragrance
The loudest objection to worship coming from the thief
Palm branches of the feast and Hosanna on the road
A King lowly enough to ride a donkey's colt
Greeks asking to see Him, and the hour arriving
A grain of wheat buried to become a harvest
John's Gethsemane: for this hour I came
One voice from heaven heard as thunder, an angel, or the Father
Lifted up, meaning the death He would die and the people He would draw
Isaiah's throne vision, and John saying the one on it was Yahshua
High and lifted up: the throne and the cross in the same words
Belief that stayed hidden for love of the praise of men

parts.title: Major Themes Across John 13-15
items: A supper before the Passover, dated by John himself
Loved to the end, in the language of it is finished
All things in His hands, and what He did with them was pick up a towel
Garments laid down and taken up, the cross acted out in a room
Feet washed, including the feet of the man who would betray Him
Pride dressed up as humility, refusing to be served
Bathed once, and washed daily of what the road picks up
A morsel of honor handed to a traitor
He went out, and it was night
Love your neighbor, now measured by as I have loved you
Known by love for one another
A failure foretold, and comfort spoken before it happened
The Father's house, larger than any building, coming down to dwell with people
A promise that is first a Person and then a place
The way, the truth, and the life, the only door that could be opened
The answer to Moses's prayer standing in front of Philip
Love and obedience in the words of the ten commandments
Another Counselor of the same kind, within and not only beside
The Spirit who causes us to walk in His statutes
No orphans, and a home made by the Father and the Son
Peace in the middle of the trouble, not by its removal
The true vine where Israel the vine had failed
Pruning that falls on the fruitful branches
Remain, said about ten times in ten verses
Apart from Him, nothing
Vine wood good only for the vine or the fire
The Son who kept His Father's commandments
Joy as the goal of all the cutting and remaining
Greater love, spoken the night before He showed it
Servants no longer, but friends, like Abraham and Moses
Chosen by Him, not choosing Him
Hated without a cause, and sent to testify anyway

parts.title: Major Themes Across John 16-18
items: Persecution foretold so that it would confirm faith instead of breaking it
Men who kill and believe they are serving God
Grief so full it stopped asking questions
The advantage of His going: the Spirit with every one of them everywhere
Sin, righteousness, and judgment, with the prince already judged
Truth given at the pace a person can carry it
A little while, said seven times, meaning three days
Sorrow turned into joy, not replaced by it
Labor pains that end in your dead shall live
A Father who does not need persuading to love
Scattered sheep, and a Shepherd who was not alone
Peace in Him and pressure in the world, and the world already overcome
A prayer spoken aloud so that we could hear it
Names carried before the Father like the stones on the high priest's shoulders
Eternal life defined as knowing Him
The glory Yahweh gives to no other, asked for by the Son
The Father's name given to the Son
Kept in the world, not taken out of it
Sanctified by the word, which is truth
Prayed for before we were born: those who would believe through their word
Oneness as the evidence that the Father sent the Son
Love before the foundation of the world
A king crossing the Kidron, betrayed by a friend
A garden where the last Adam was arrested
Lanterns and torches searching for the light of the world
I am, and an armed company on the ground
A shepherd stepping between the soldiers and the sheep
The cup received, not refused
I am, and I am not: the Master and the disciple on the same night
Two charcoal fires, one for denial and one for restoration
Struck on the cheek, and asking for justice rather than staying silent
Careful not to be defiled while delivering the innocent to death
A kingdom not from this world, which does not run on swords
What is truth, asked of the truth, without waiting for an answer
No fault found in the Lamb

parts.title: Major Themes Across John 19-21
items: Thorns from the curse, worn as a crown by the one who came to lift it
Behold the man, a pagan governor quoting Zechariah without knowing it
The Lamb examined three times and found without defect
Power over Him given only from above
We have no king but Caesar, from the men who led Yahweh's worship
The Son carrying the wood up the hill, as Isaac did
A sign in three languages telling the truth Pilate would not stand for
A seamless tunic, woven like the robe of the high priest
A mother given a son from the cross
The giver of living water, thirsty
Hyssop, the plant that marked the Passover blood on the doorposts
It is finished: paid in full
A spirit given up, not taken
A special Sabbath, and two Sabbaths in one week
Not a bone broken, like the Passover lamb
They will look on Him whom they pierced, spoken by Yahweh of Himself
Secret disciples brought into the open by the cross
A king's burial in a new tomb in a garden
A tomb found already empty, before dawn, on the day of firstfruits
Grave clothes left lying, and a head cloth folded by itself
Two angels at the head and feet, like the cherubim of the mercy seat
The last Adam mistaken for the gardener
One word, her name, and she knew His voice
Brothers for the first time, and a Father shared
Peace spoken first to the men who ran
Wounds still carried by the risen body
Breath on the disciples as on the first man and Ezekiel's slain
Forgiveness handed over first, where deliverance begins
The doubter's exact words offered back to him
My Lord and my God: the frame of the book closing
Blessed are those who have not seen
A night of nothing and a word from the shore
Two charcoal fires, denial and restoration
Breakfast cooked by the risen Lord
Three questions for three denials
Restoration that is a commission, not a probation
What is that to you? You follow Me
